# Holds pickup shelf rules

Holds wait on the pickup shelf for seven days after the patron is notified. Shelve them by the patron's last name, using the hold slip that arrived with the item on the [[Van route timetable|van run]].

Uncollected holds go back into transit the next weekday so the next patron in the queue gets them. Patrons can ask staff to extend a hold once, for three more days. Staff should never lend a waiting hold to a different patron at the desk.
